intro.text: A figure of the past who warns of unintended side effects from a step meant to deny the parsh forms of power, though Melishi is confident in it.
A Shin woman from the time of Ba-Ado-Mishram's capture, quoted in the gem archive at Urithiru.

items.text: Naze warned that Melishi's plan to trap Ba-Ado-Mishram in a perfect gemstone could have unintended effects, a warning noted in the gem archive. In a vision in the Spiritual Realm, Dalinar took her place at one of Garith's peace talks with the singers and sat with the Radiants afterwards. When Melishi asked for Naze's support, Dalinar, in her place, gave it.
